Sve pohvale za ceo tim,strucnost i brzina na pvom mestu,maksimalno ljubazni.Doktorica je dosla do sobe hotela gde smo odseli,tako da nismo morali nikuda da idemo,sto nam je zaista bilo bitno,jer se radilo o bebama,a vrucine i guzve su velike.
Sve preporuke od srca.Hvala vam jos jednom na svemu.💜

I got sick during my visit to Montenegro. Since I had my traveling insurance, they have forwarded my call to Vranes Medical. 15minutes later, I have received a phone call from Dr. Vranes, letting me know they will be at my address in 10-15 minutes. Everything went as agreed, and hopefully the whole matter is closed. Many thanks for the fast reaction and kind approach to the Vranes Medical. Great recommendation!!!

Sve pohvale.
Veoma profesionalni i usluzni i resavaju problem u veoma kratkom roku. Sve najlepse.
Stručnost, ljubaznost i ekspeditivnost! Sve pohvale!

Fast arrival at the address, thanks for the expertise!

Koristili smo uslugu putnog zdravstvenog osiguranja. Brzo je organizovan pregled. Sve je bilo ok!

Everything is cool!

Fantastic service! I was vacationing in Montenegro with my family, when me and my daughter got sick.

Our travel insurance recommended Medical Vranes, and their team handled everything seamlessly for us. Since the infirmary closest to us was closed at the time, they even suggested sending a doctor directly to our home! We ended up visiting their clinic in Budva where we had a great experience as well!

I hope you don't get sick while vacationing in Montenegro as we did, but if you do - Medical Vranes is the place to call first!
